notes: Jetcaster's phone/tablet client, the Material 3 Expressive adaptive podcast sample. :mobile declares 11 @Preview functions, all catalogued; DevicePreviews is declared in the same module. JetcasterTheme is dark-only (no light scheme), so the spec declares a single theme. The Wear client is the sibling import compose-samples-jetcaster-wear. Built from UNMODIFIED upstream android/compose-samples (main), replacing the catalog preview.coo.ee served from the yschimke/compose-samples fork: that fork's `previews` branch carried roughly ten thousand lines of catalog-only preview sources that no longer apply to upstream, and none of them is carried over — this import renders upstream's own @Preview functions only, and every spec entry names one. The Theme control comes from the sample's own theme composable via `themes` in the spec, replacing the fork's re-themed Material 3 tab. Each sample is its own Gradle build in a subdirectory of the repository, hence workingDirectory. Licence: Apache-2.0.
